textbookBox.concept: Four friends, Circle, Square, Triangle and Rectangle, begin to fight about who is the best. Circle says she is round and beautiful with no sharp edges, and children use her to draw a smiling face.

beats.speakEn: Four friends, Circle, Square, Triangle and Rectangle, begin to fight about who is the best. Circle says she is round and beautiful with no sharp edges, and children use her to draw a smiling face.

beats.en: The friends cannot decide, so they agree to ask the first person they meet. They meet a star. The wise star says they are all friends and should not fight.

textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 3 english · Best Friends (story) · Deeper Textbook Ideas
textbookBox.concept: A circle is round and has no sharp edges or corners. A square has four sides that are all equal. A triangle has three sides. A rectangle has four straight sides and four square corners.

beats.en: A circle is round and has no sharp edges or corners. A square has four sides that are all equal. A triangle has three sides. A rectangle has four straight sides and four square corners.
beats.speakEn: A circle is round and has no sharp edges or corners. A square has four sides that are all equal. A triangle has three sides. A rectangle has four straight sides and four square corners.

beats.en: We use a before a singular noun that begins with a consonant sound, such as a dog, a cow and a sparrow. We use an before a singular naming word that starts with a vowel sound.
